rules.prepare:
# As in Debian: the build is the one with make, cmake only writes the files # that tell other cmake projects about the library. mkdir -p "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/_cmake" cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/_cmake"
cmake \ -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=Linux \ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-g++" \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM=NEVER \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY=ONLY \ -DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE=ONLY \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib \ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo \ -DZSTD_LEGACY_SUPPORT:BOOL=ON \ -DBUILD_TESTING:BOOL=OFF \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/build/cmake"
rules.build:
export CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" export CXX="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-g++" export V=1
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" -C contrib/pzstd
rules.install:
export CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" export CXX="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-g++"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" \ LIBDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ install make PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" \ -C contrib/pzstd \ install
CMAKE_DIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/cmake/zstd"
mkdir -p "$CMAKE_DIR" cp _cmake/zstdConfig*.cmake "$CMAKE_DIR/" cp _cmake/CMakeFiles/Export/*/zstdTargets*.cmake "$CMAKE_DIR/"
